# absinthe_altair v2026.5.1 - Table of Contents

A Plug for embedding the Altair GraphQL Client into Absinthe applications

## Modules

- [AbsintheAltair](https://absinthe-altair.hexdocs.pm/AbsintheAltair.md): A Plug for embedding the [Altair GraphQL Client](https://altairgraphql.dev)
into Phoenix and Absinthe applications.
- [AbsintheAltair.Assets](https://absinthe-altair.hexdocs.pm/AbsintheAltair.Assets.md): Manages CDN URLs for the Altair GraphQL Client static assets.

- [AbsintheAltair.Config](https://absinthe-altair.hexdocs.pm/AbsintheAltair.Config.md): Handles configuration resolution and JavaScript initialization for the
Altair GraphQL Client plug.
